call_points.text: Management expects positive impact from Q2FY27 onwards as agriculture activity normalizes
Volume degrowth of 13% in Q1FY27 with 2% value growth due to premium product mix
Gross margin expanded by 240 bps YoY to 31.6% supported by premium product mix and some inventory benefits
Capex expected to normalize around ₹30-40 Cr annually after completion of current projects
Working capital cycle to improve as season normalizes, with focus on inventory turns and collections
Kaeros targeting 100% CAGR initially, with margins expected to remain single digit in the near term

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 3 Per Share

guidance.statement: Expected positive impact from Q2FY27 onwards as agriculture activity normalizes
Premium product mix to reach 70% in next 3-4 years

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Fertilizers & Agrochemicals > Pesticides & Agrochemicals

operating_notes.text: Granuvia generated ₹5 Cr in Q1FY27, expected to reach ₹20 Cr in FY27
Spinoace generated ₹0.25 Cr in Q1FY27 (launched late July), expected to reach ₹10 Cr in FY27
Premium product mix increased to 64% of B2C in Q1FY27 from 58% in Q1FY26

timeline.summary: Insecticides (India) Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 11, 2026, reporting revenue decline of 12% YoY to ₹612 Cr but gross margin expansion to 31.6%, with management expecting recovery from Q2 onwards

watchlist.response: Management mentioned variations as high as 25-30% in solvent prices week-to-week, making it difficult to pass on costs completely
watchlist.text: Volatility in raw material prices (solvents, plastics, emulsifiers) affecting margins

watchlist.response: Management expects sales returns to reduce to at least half of previous year's ₹200 Cr due to cautious placement and strategic product mix
watchlist.text: Sales returns possibility due to delayed monsoon
